svg.title: Slope field of dN/dt equals 0.0005 N times 1200 minus N, for t from 0 to 15 years and N from 0 to 1600. Segments along each row are parallel. They are horizontal on the dashed line N equals 1200, rise between N equals 0 and 1200, steepest near N equals 600, and fall above 1200. One solution starts at N equals 300, rises in an S shape and levels off just below 1200. Another starts at N equals 1500 and falls, levelling off just above 1200.
